requirements.specification: Complete the partial R6 implementation in one isolated controlled-manual worktree.
Persist immutable ontology evidence and bind its exact identity/hash to governed baseline and recipe provenance without altering frozen canonical bytes.
Lifecycle compatibility and ontology checks are transactional, fail closed, and leave durable audit evidence for rejection.
Draft-only re-pin uses an exact preview-bound impact diff, optimistic concurrency, and never silently substitutes a baseline.
API/HMI exposes actionable pin and compatibility state; deprecated POST /publish is removed and POST /make-effective remains governed.
Focused domain, PostgreSQL API/migration, authorization, negative and UI tests plus build and hygiene gates pass before independent two-axis review.

Only the documented coordinator seed commit exists in the isolated worktree; the cycle makes no further commit, transfer, push, deploy, external database/runtime, Synology, or out-of-allowlist mutation.
